 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ajay Mukherjee, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dashrath Mehta, App
 For the O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Kamlesh Kumar Pathak, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar

2 19-10-2023 Heard Mr. Ajay Mukherjee, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, Mr. Kamlesh Kumar Pathak, learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner happens to be husband of the O.P. No. 2 apprehends his arrest in connection with Rajoun P.S. Case No. 154 of 2023, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323,
504 and 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Allegedly, the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with O.P. No. 2 on 15.01.2021, however,
soon after the marriage, she was subjected to demand of dowry and on Patna High Court CR.

MISC.
No.64765 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 account of non fulfillment of the same, she was tortured in various ways, resulting into lodging of the present FIR.

Awdhesh Yadav @ Awdhesh Kumar Yadav@ ... vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3305360/
1 4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that though the petitioner is himself being tortured at the hands of the O.P. No. 2, but considering the nature of the offences and dispute between the husband and the wife, if the matter would be sent to the Mediation Centre,
Patna High Court, there may be a chance of amicable settlement.
5. Learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 also submits that if the petitioner is ready to keep the O.P. No.
2 with all dignity and honour, she want to live with him and, as such, it would be proper that the matter may be referred to the Mediation Centre, Patna High Court.
6.
Both the parties are, hereby, directed to appear on 09.11.2023 before the Patna High Court Mediation Centre along with a copy of this order.

On receipt thereof, after affording proper opportunity of hearing to them, efforts shall be made by the learned Mediator for a mutually acceptable settlement between the parties and a report thereafter be submitted to the Court by the Patna High Court Mediation Centre.
7.
It is expected that the mediation process shall be Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64765 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 completed expeditiously.

8. List this matter on 18.12.2023 along with the report of the Patna High Court Mediation Centre.
9.
In the meantime, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Rajoun P.S. Case No. 154 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Banka.

(Harish Kumar, J) shivank/-
